name: Cidoxepin
summary: Cidoxepin (former developmental code name P-4599), also known as cis-doxepin or (Z)-doxepin, is a tricyclic antidepressant which was developed in the 1960s but was never marketed. It is the cis or (Z) stereoisomer of doxepin, a mixture of (E) and (Z) isomers that is used commercially in a ratio of approximately 17:3 with cidoxepin as a relatively minor constituent.

pharmacology.text: The central anticholinergic activity of cidoxepin has been reported to be 3-fold greater than that of the trans isomer in mice.

uses.text: Cidoxepin (former developmental code name P-4599), also known as cis-doxepin or (Z)-doxepin, is a tricyclic antidepressant which was developed in the 1960s but was never marketed. It is the cis or (Z) stereoisomer of doxepin, a mixture of (E) and (Z) isomers that is used commercially in a ratio of approximately 17:3 with cidoxepin as a relatively minor constituent.

summaryZh: 西多塞平（英語：Cidoxepin，開發代碼：P-4599，也稱為順式-多塞平，cis-doxepin，或-多塞平，-doxepin）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式為C19H21NO，屬於三環類抗抑鬱藥，與多塞平是順反異構體，1960年代開發，從未上市銷售。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it on its own. Drugs of its class, the tricyclic antidepressants, can cause drowsiness, dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision and weight gain, and in overdose can cause dangerous heart rhythm problems, seizures and death.
sideEffects.zh: 它單獨的作用所知甚少。同類的三環抗憂鬱藥可能造成嗜睡、口乾、便秘、視力模糊與體重增加，過量時可能造成危險的心律不整、癲癇發作甚至死亡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它单独的作用所知甚少。同类的三环抗忧郁药可能造成嗜睡、口干、便秘、视力模糊与体重增加，过量时可能造成危险的心律不整、癫痫发作甚至死亡。

fact.en: Doxepin is sold as a mix of two geometric isomers, which differ only in which side of a double bond the side chain sits on. Cidoxepin is the cis form, the minor part of that mix.
fact.zh: 多塞平是以兩種幾何異構物的混合物販售，兩者的差別只在側鏈位於雙鍵的哪一邊。西多塞平是其中的順式，也就是混合物中較少的那一種。
fact.zhHans: 多塞平是以两种几何异构物的混合物贩售，两者的差别只在侧链位于双键的哪一边。西多塞平是其中的顺式，也就是混合物中较少的那一种。
